definitions.explanation: The act of guiding or leading someone, especially helping them learn or navigate something new.
A written document that provides instructions or guidance on how to do something.

examples.japanese: {先輩|せんぱい}の{手引|てび}きで{仕事|しごと}を{覚|おぼ}えた。
examples.english: I learned the job under the guidance of my senior.

examples.japanese: {内部|ないぶ}の{人間|にんげん}が{犯人|はんにん}の{手引|てび}きをしたらしい。
examples.english: It seems an insider aided and abetted the criminal.
examples.notes: Can also mean to secretly assist someone in wrongdoing.

examples.japanese: {地元|じもと}の{人|ひと}の{手引|てび}きがなければ、この{場所|ばしょ}にはたどり{着|つ}けなかった。
examples.english: Without the guidance of a local person, I could not have reached this place.

examples.japanese: {利用|りよう}の{手引|てび}きを{読|よ}む。
{入学|にゅうがく}{手引|てび}きが{届|とど}いた。
{初心者|しょしんしゃ}のための{手引|てび}きを{作成|さくせい}した。
examples.english: I created a guide for beginners.

notes:
{手引|てび}き has two main uses: personal guidance (someone leading or helping you) and written guides or manuals.

NOTE: When used for guidance by a person, {手引|てび}き can have a negative connotation — secretly helping someone gain access or commit wrongdoing (similar to English 'inside help').

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手引|てび}きをする: to guide, to provide assistance
- {手引|てび}き{書|しょ}: guidebook, manual
- {入門|にゅうもん}の{手引|てび}き: introductory guide
- {利用|りよう}の{手引|てび}き: usage guide

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ガイド: guide (loanword, casual)
- マニュアル: manual (loanword)
- {案内|あんない}: guidance, information
